## Setup
```{r}
library("GimmmeMySC")
library("GimmeMyPlot")
library("Seurat")
library("rlist")
library("clustree")
library("magrittr")
library("harmony")

source(
  file.path(file.path(
  dirname(getwd()),
  "inst",
  "extdata"
), "conf.R"))

if (split.by == "Type") {
  integration_method <- "RPCA"
} else {
  integration_method <- "Harmony"
}
if (assay == "ATAC") {
  slot <- "data"
} else {
  slot <- "scale.data"
}
```

## Load data
```{r}
load(file.path(path_data, paste0(seurat_dataset, ".rda")))
# seurat@assays$SCT@scale.data <- matrix()
if (split.by == "Patient")
  seurat <- subset(seurat, subset = Type == target_type)
DefaultAssay(seurat) <- assay
```

```{r}
eig <- seurat[[reduction]]@stdev / sum(seurat[[reduction]]@stdev) * 100
plot_pca_qc(eig)

cumsum(eig) %>% .[n_dim] %>% round(1)
cumsum(eig) %>% .[. < 80] %>% last() %>% round(1)
```

```{r, fig.height = 6, fig.width = 12}
list.map(
  list(seq(15), 16:30, 31:45),
  ~DimHeatmap(seurat, dims = ., cells = 500, balanced = TRUE, reduction = reduction, assays = assay, slot = slot)
)
```

```{r}
comp_genes <- list.map(
    dims,
    f(x) ~ Loadings(seurat, reduction = reduction) %>%
        as.data.frame() %>%
        set_colnames(str_replace(colnames(.), "(\\w+)_(\\d+)", "PC_\\2")) %>%
        select(paste0("PC_", x)) %>%
        arrange(abs(!!sym(paste0("PC_", x)))) %>%
        tail(20) %>%
        rownames()
) %>% set_names(dims)

if (assay == "ATAC") {
  dims <- filter_depth_cor(seurat) %>% head(n_dim)
} else {
  list.map(
    lapply(cc.genes, func_format),
    f(i) ~lapply(comp_genes, function(x) x[x %in% func_format(i)]) %>% compact()
  ) %>% set_names(c("G2/M", "S"))
}
```

## Integration
```{r}
if (assay == "ATAC") {
  seurat@assays[["ATAC_v5"]] <- CreateAssay5Object(
    counts = seurat@assays$ATAC$counts, 
    data = seurat@assays$ATAC$data
  )
  seurat@assays[["ATAC_v5"]]@key <- "atacv5_"
  
  DefaultAssay(seurat) <- "ATAC_v5"
  seurat <- ScaleData(seurat)
  seurat[["ATAC_v5"]] <- split(
    seurat[["ATAC_v5"]], 
    f = seurat[[]][, split.by],
    layers = c("counts","data")
  )
} else {
    seurat[[assay]] <- split(
        seurat[[assay]],
        f = seurat[[]][, split.by],
        layers = c("counts", "data")
    )
}
gc()
```

```{r}
if (assay == "ATAC") {
  seurat <- IntegrateLayers(
    object = seurat, 
    method = get(paste0(integration_method, "Integration")),
    new.reduction = integration_method,
    features = Features(seurat@assays[["ATAC_v5"]]),
    orig.reduction = reduction,
    assay = "ATAC_v5",
    dims.to.integrate = dims,
    verbose = TRUE
  )
} else {
    seurat <- IntegrateLayers(
        object = seurat,
        method = get(paste0(integration_method, "Integration")),
        new.reduction = integration_method,
        orig.reduction = reduction,
        dims.to.integrate = dims,
        normalization.method = ifelse(SCT, "SCT", "LogNormalize"),
        verbose = TRUE
    )
    seurat[["RNA"]] <- JoinLayers(seurat[["RNA"]])
}

Idents(seurat) <- split.by
```

## Clustering
```{r clus_int}
resolution2 <- seq(.1, .4, 0.05)
resolution <- c(seq(.5, 1, by = 0.1), 1.2, 1.5)
resolution_tot <- c(resolution2, resolution)
seurat <- FindNeighbors(
  seurat,
  reduction = integration_method, 
  dims = dims
)

seurat <- FindClusters(
  seurat,
  verbose = FALSE,
  algorithm = 3,
  resolution = resolution_tot,
  graph.name = tail(names(seurat@graphs), 1)
)

seurat2 <- seurat
prefix_cl <- paste0(assay, "_snn_res.")
cols_to_remove <- paste0(prefix_cl, resolution[-1])
seurat2@meta.data <- seurat2@meta.data[, !colnames(seurat2@meta.data) %in% cols_to_remove]

select(seurat@meta.data, contains(prefix_cl)) %>%
     list.mapv(f(x) ~ levels(x) %>% length()) %>% 
    set_names(names(.) %>% str_remove(prefix_cl)) %>%
  plot_bar_sc0(label_y = "value", sort = "desc")
```

```{r}
clusters <- grep(prefix_cl, colnames(seurat[[]]), value = TRUE) %>% sort()
kable_cluster(
  seurat,
  clusters, 
  file = file.path(path_fig, "clusters.png"),
  assay = assay
)
grep(prefix_cl, colnames(seurat2[[]]), value = TRUE) %>% sort() %>%
  kable_cluster(
    seurat,
    ., 
    file = file.path(path_fig, "clusters2.png"),
    assay = assay
)
```

```{r, fig.width = 20, fig.height = 10}
clustree_sc(seurat, prefix_cl, clusters)
```

```{r, fig.width = 16, fig.height = 8}
clustree_sc(seurat2, prefix_cl, clusters)
```

```{r, fig.height = 5, fig.width = 10}
plot_res(seurat, clusters)
plot_res(
  seurat, 
  clusters[c(3, 5, 6, 8)],
  ncol = 2
  )
plot_res(
  seurat,
  clusters,
  cols = scales::hue_pal()
)
```

## Save data
```{r}
if (assay == "ATAC") {
  DefaultAssay(seurat) <- "ATAC" 
   seurat@assays$ATAC_v5 <- NULL
}

Idents(seurat) <- seurat[[]][, snn_cluster]
if (split.by == "Patient") {
  save(seurat, file = file.path(path_data, paste0(seurat_dataset, "_", target_type, ".rda")))
} else {
  save(seurat, file = file.path(path_data, paste0(seurat_dataset, ".rda")))
}
```
